text: Qatar halted LNG production after drone strikes hit facilities at Ras Laffan and Mesaieed. Approximately 20% of global LNG exports transit the Gulf via the Strait of Hormuz. European gas futures surged, with U.K. contracts up ~50% and Dutch futures up >45%. Shares of U.S. LNG exporters rose. Saudi infrastructure was also targeted.

meta.note: Event spans infrastructure damage and market repricing within one time block.
